_comment: Which wireframe covers which visualiser THIS instance (who-iris) declares, by route key `<instance>/<visualiser>`. The same shape as cat-harness/docs/wireframes/index.json, which held this entry until 2026-10-15: a wireframe sits with the page it draws, and check:wireframes reads every instance's `<site>/wireframes/index.json` (cat-harness-tools#281). In cat-harness's index this ref read as undeclared in any checkout that did not mount who-iris. `wireframe.css` is the shared mid-fidelity stylesheet, copied from cat-harness/docs/wireframes/ so the drawing renders here on its own.
